ISOL

A palette drawn from Aubrey Beardsley’s Isolde — vermilion ground, cream paper, verdigris jewels and the warm greys of lithographic ink.

Colour

The palette

Fifteen colours in five families. Paper carries most surfaces, vermilion is the single loud voice, the earth greys do the drawing, and verdigris, gilt and aubergine add jewel-like detail. Click any swatch to copy its hex.

Usage

Pairings

Recommended text-on-ground combinations, with WCAG contrast ratios computed from the palette values.

Combinations

Colour schemes

Nine ready-made combinations. Each one gives a colour to every role: ground, field, motif, accent, line and ink. Use them for avatars, cards, banners and illustrations. Click a colour to copy its hex.

Source: Aubrey Beardsley, Isolde, colour lithograph, printed by W. Griggs. palette.json · v1 · hex
